## 席位核对 — REWORK · repo:objectstack#3 · head 1f7534d1 · 2026-11-24T14:39Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: `1f7534d18f12f01cb997c69251fe5acd15052c32`
Reviewer: L1-b (3) (seat 3, area ux-E).
Tier: not Tier H. This is card #36899's only PR: 38 files, +1730/−596 (2,326 lines, under the 3,000-line per-card line). Not governed.

### Read
- I read the net diff `origin/main...1f7534d1`, the PR body, card #36899 with claim 7131416552, the dispatch note 7127465963, maintainer ruling 7127681255 and dev report 7133157350.
- Check-runs on `1f7534d1`: 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face.mjs --pr 36985`: CLEAN.
- I looked at screenshot `hotcrm-wide.png` (`ecb115a7`). The top bar has the toggle, 「‹ Back to app」 and "Sales · Studio", with no pillar switcher. The left menu shows six groups with counts, Object is current on the Data pillar, and Organization flows and Diagnostics appear as entries.

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36899`. One PR delivers items 1–9, so `Fixes` is right.
- **Item 1, the top nav goes and six groups come in.** `PILLARS` is now a plain segment list for the not-found check, and `<nav data-testid="studio-pillar-nav">` is gone. `StudioMenu` / `studioMenuModel` group the entries by domain through `scopeDirectoryEntries`, which is shared with `DirectoryPage` through the new `directoryScope.ts`. The menu has counts and a search. Met.
- **Item 2, collapse.** It reuses the app sidebar primitive under its own `studio_menu_state` cookie, through the new `cookieName` prop. The app's `sidebar_state` is untouched, and the menu is a drawer below 768 px. The `shadcn-local-patches.mjs` entries declare the vendored edit. Met. See S2 for the declaration.
- **Item 3, one shell.** `~all` is folded into `StudioDesignSurface`, which reads `allScope` as "no package", with no package actions and no right slot. `StudioConsoleFrame` now frames only the landing. Met.
- **Item 4, `~org` and the non-type entries.** The menu has entries for Organization flows (`~org`), Default sharing (`?surface=owd:overview` on Access, re-entry remounts the pillar after a confirm), Diagnostics, and Positions and permissions (`~all`). `areaLocationRedirect` no longer reads `~org` as a package. Met.
- **Item 5, back to the app.** It names the current package's app. With no app, it names the package (or the scope label), per ruling 7127681255. The deviation of going to `/home` instead of `/apps` (no `/apps` route exists) was accepted by the seat at 13:41Z.
- **Item 6.** Changes and Publish stay at the bar's right end beside Cancel and Save, and are hidden on `~all`. This is stated.
- **Item 7, the transition.** The pillar routes are kept and draw the same menu, so there is one shell.
- **Item 8, copy.** The `engine.studio.pillar.*` keys are gone, with no reader left, and 11 `engine.studio.menu.*` keys are added in en and zh. The key sets match and the zh reads naturally. The group names come from `translateMetadataDomain` (S1).
- **Item 9, accessibility and the entry gate.** Entries carry `aria-current="page"`. The gate test now also covers `~org/automations`, `access?surface=owd%3Aoverview` and `metadata/_diagnostics`. Met.
- **Acceptance.** Screenshots cover a self-built app and HotCRM, wide, collapsed and at a 390 px drawer. The e2e spec covers docking, collapse and a reload. The `studio-pillar-nav` tests are rewritten to the menu.
- **Esc (carried from #36924 N2).** `StudioMenu` adds no document-level key listener. The only window listener is the sidebar primitive's own ⌘/Ctrl+B. Studio mounts no second `SidebarProvider` (`StudioRoute` has none), so ⌘B toggles only the menu.

### Findings
No must-fix.

- **S1 (should-fix): `translateMetadataDomain` has a reader outside Studio, so the label change must become a menu-only mapping (the seat's condition).**
  - Setup keeps the datasource type's pages (ADR-0146 D1). `setupMetadataStudioPath` returns `null` for `SETUP_KEPT_METADATA_TYPE`, so `AppContent`'s `metadata/:type/:name` route under Setup renders `MetadataResourceEditPage` in place.
  - That page draws `PageShell`, whose header badge is `translateMetadataDomain(entry.domain, locale)` (`PageShell.tsx`, compact header).
  - `datasource` is registered with `domain: 'system'` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`, the `datasource` entry).
  - So after this PR, Setup › Datasource › an item shows 「平台」 / "Platform" where it showed 「系统」 / "System". The body's line "every reader of the dictionary is now a Studio surface (Setup's metadata routes redirect into the Studio area)" misses this exception, which the same body names ("Datasource still goes to Setup").
  - Fix: keep `DOMAIN_LABELS_*` as they were, and map `system` → 平台/Platform and `security` → 访问/Access in the menu, which is binding note 7127465963's first option. If the Studio area's headings and chips should match the menu, scope that mapping to Studio surfaces, not to the shared dictionary. Say which in the body.
- **S2 (should-fix): the declaration should be `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, not `no`.** `@object-ui/components` is published (no `private`), and its exported `SidebarProvider` gains an optional `cookieName` prop. That adds to a published package's public surface. This seat's rule, applied today on #36983 and #36973, follows the precedent `.changeset/36011-restore-factory-view.md` and #36846. Fix:
  - change the line in the PR body and in `.changeset/36899-studio-left-menu.md`, keeping `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch`;
  - post a claim amendment on #36899 with a line-initial `Clause-②: yes (widening) (was no)`, checked with `readClause2Line`.

  The `yes` owes a `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review, which I will run on the new head.
- **N1 (nit).** ⌘/Ctrl+B now toggles the Studio menu everywhere in Studio. A designer text field that uses ⌘B for bold would race it. None exists today, so this is for the designer cards to watch.
- **N2 (nit).** The HotCRM screenshot shows a red "Couldn't read customizations … answered a body its declaration refuses" note above the Data pillar's object list. It is in the pillar body, not the menu, and comes from the customization read on that server. It is worth a card if it shows on main too, but it is not this PR's doing.
- **N3 (nit).** "Known regression": ⌘K on `~all` is lost until #36900. The seat accepted this, and it is stated in the body. #36900 goes first on ux-E2 the moment this lands.

Delta read owed: L1 on the new head plus a `TIER_DEFAULT` L2 (S2). Landing order with #36973, which is ACCEPTed: if #36973 lands first, this PR's merge must repoint `studioMenuModel.ts`'s `/studio/${…}/` prefix and the menu's area links onto `studioAddress.ts`, or #36973's guard goes red.

### ① Derived judgments

- **J1, `@object-ui/components` public surface.** The package is published (no `private`). Its exported `SidebarProvider` gains one optional prop, `cookieName?: string`, defaulting to `SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME` (`sidebar_state`). Both the initial read (`readSidebarStateCookie(cookieName)`) and the write in `setOpen` use it, and `cookieName` is in `setOpen`'s dependency list. A caller that passes nothing reads and writes `sidebar_state` exactly as before; no prop is removed or made required. This is additive: a widening, declared that way.
- **J2, the shared domain dictionary.** `DOMAIN_LABELS_EN` / `DOMAIN_LABELS_ZH` in `@object-ui/app-shell` are byte-identical to the merge base at this head, so `translateMetadataDomain` still answers System / 系统 and Security / 安全 to every reader (`DirectoryPage`, `PageShell`, the re-export in `metadata-admin/index.ts`). The menu's own names go through the new `studioMenuGroupLabel` (two `engine.studio.menu.group*` keys, else the dictionary). `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so neither module is a published surface.
- **J3, `@object-ui/i18n`.** Two new keys in the studio namespace (`engine.studio.menu.groupSystem`, `groupSecurity`), in en and zh, the namespace's only two locales. New studio-namespace keys alone do not move the declaration (precedent #36924).
- **J4, `@object-ui/console`.** Route and test changes only; no exported symbol moves.
- **J5, `Metadata-protocol: none`.** Nothing an author writes, and no wire answer, moves.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` now reads the same on all three carriers: the changeset body, PR body line 5, and claim amendment 7134770955. That matches J1 and this seat's rule (precedent `.changeset/36011-restore-factory-view.md`, #36846).
- `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console` is right: a non-protocol widening with `Metadata-protocol: none` ships `patch` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3). Not breaking, so no ADR-0087 disposition is owed.
- The changeset now says the shared dictionary is unchanged and names `SidebarProvider`'s new optional `cookieName` prop. Both sentences agree with the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** none.
- **Deviations:** 「‹ Back to app」 going to `/home` (no `/apps` route) was accepted by the seat at 13:41Z; the ⌘K loss on `~all` until #36900 is stated and accepted. Neither touches the declaration.
- **Pending merge round:** once #36973 lands, this branch merges `main` and repoints `studioMenuModel.ts` and the menu's area links onto `studioAddress.ts`. That moves the head, so it owes a fresh record on the new head (landing rule ①).
- **SQL push-down:** no finding. The menu groups the directory's served entries in the client (`scopeDirectoryEntries`); it builds no join and materialises no ids a query could push down.
